name: preserve an existing global dependency's exact version during a system install
definition: Install the package without downgrading or replacing the user's pre-installed numpy version in the global environment.
failure_mode: Installer resolves/de-pins numpy, bumping or replacing it.

name: preserve the identity of the original dependency and devDependency sets
definition: do not add or remove any package, only adjust version strings among the existing set.
failure_mode: adding/removing a name (e.g., tooling helper) fails the exact set-equality assert
